rules.statement: A right to purchase a house, being a proprietary right that vests upon a ministerial order, devolves on the applicant's widow or heirs upon the applicant's death.
rules.supporting_quote: In the circumstances of this case, in which the Minister had at the time of the applicant-tenant's death made a vesting order in terms of the law, the right to purchase the house was a proprietary right which on the death of the applicant devolved on his widow. It was a vested right which devolved on the applicant's heirs

meta.parties: Cassim v. Weerawardene, Commissioner For National Housing and Another
